description: Turn an image into ASCII art: each character cell takes the average brightness of its area (cells are twice as tall as wide) and maps it onto a character ramp: standard " .:-=+*#%@", detailed (70 characters), blocks " ░▒▓█", simple, binary, or your own. Contrast, brightness and invert (for light text on dark backgrounds). Returns the text; format "png" also renders it to an image (optionally in the image's colours). Transparent areas count as white paper. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/ascii-art/

color.description: PNG only: colour each character with the image colour.

customRamp.description: Characters for ramp "custom", from no ink to most ink (at least 2).

image.description: The image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

invert.description: For light text on a dark background. Default false.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

ramp.description: Character set, light → dark. Default standard.

name: image_ascii_art
title: Image to ASCII art
